fixed_geometry.trial_motion: x50(s)=x50(0)+s*n, with both signs and deterministic increments; derive actual shortest contact distance with the source contact algorithm. This geometric trajectory is a synthetic witness, not a forecast of aircraft motion.
fixed_geometry.geometry_caveat: Nonplanar four-node facet and exact vertex coincidence: do not equate s blindly to native distance, normal, facet sector or contact force.

state_policy.pair_key: interface persistent ID, secondary persistent node ID, main persistent facet ID; internal indices only via verified maps
state_policy.eligibility: Only certified cohesive-neighbour initial pairs could be WAITING. Uncertified pairs remain ARMED with ordinary contact and cause preparation failure if overlapping.
state_policy.initialize: Certified initially overlapping seam pair WAITING; every initially clean/new/unrelated pair ARMED; uncertified initial overlap is a model gate failure.
state_policy.evaluate: WAITING force, contact tangent and contact energy are exactly zero for this pair. Preserve ordinary geometric distance, normal and nominal gap. ARMED uses unchanged TYPE7 force, matrix, friction and energy branches.
state_policy.arm: After an accepted converged configuration is genuinely outside the unchanged native contact envelope, commit ARMED permanently. Prefer clear d>g+roundoff_guard; roundoff guard must be a numeric tolerance, not a gap change.
state_policy.newton: Maintain trial and committed state separately. A failed trial, line search or rejected step must not commit. Pending state transitions must be recomputed consistently when a step is retried. Irreversible committed arming may occur only on accepted geometry.
state_policy.sort_restart: Pair identity and state persist through candidate disappearance, reappearance, reordering and restart. Restart restores WAITING before exit and ARMED after exit. A recreated candidate must never be treated as initially overlapping anew.
state_policy.unresolved_commit_design: Exact accepted-step hook, trial state copying and supported restart format/schema version are unresolved; this prevents a reviewable diff today.
state_policy.cohesive_gate: Prove the unchanged seam law supports intended compression before arming and preserves rupture after the new contact gate. If a failed seam can interpenetrate before full gap exit with no adequate compression reaction, stop this policy.
state_policy.stop_reason: A0.3mmopening may fail currentLAW117 before0.5mmgapexit. Pure geometric waiting cannot guarantee recontact after rupture and partial opening; do not implement it as proposed.

force_matrix_criteria: WAITING: no pair force, pair tangent or pair energy; cohesive terms unchanged.
ARMED: same reactions, ordinary gap and tangent as baseline TYPE7 on an initially clean witness driven to the same native geometry.

Directional finite differences of force match assembled tangent for fixed active set and away from contact/arming transitions; separately observe the transition and do not demand differentiability at the switch.
Action-reaction, impulse and energy closure use independent residuals and established budgets; do not infer success from exit0 or zero singular-error count.
Native implicit selector has a0.97-gap inner criterion in I7DSTR3; tests near that boundary must inspect its actual baseline force/matrix semantics, not assume exact gap threshold equality.
